answer: To counter Sybil attacks, an agent economy can enforce hardware enclave attestation. At the dawn of each epoch, an agent submits a cryptographic proof from a secure coprocessor, verifying it as a legitimate execution vertex. An adversary incurs the verifiable cost of procuring distinct physical silicon chips per identity. However, microcode vulnerabilities and side-channel leakage can compromise signing keys, leaving trust assumptions to crumble like brittle shale.
